# Dezzyne

> Dezzyne, LLC is an independent software studio building standalone games,
> crafting social virtual worlds (UGCE), and publishing production-ready tools
> that accelerate game studio workflows.

## Studio Pillars

- [About](https://www.dezzyne.com/about/): Overview of Dezzyne, LLC and our
  three core focus areas.
- [Games](https://www.dezzyne.com/games/): Standalone games developed and
  published by Dezzyne, LLC.
- [UGCE](https://www.dezzyne.com/ugce/): Social virtual worlds and user
  generated content experiences crafted by Dezzyne.
- [Tooling](https://www.dezzyne.com/tooling/): Production-ready Unity editor
  extensions, shaders, and pipeline utilities available via the Unity Asset
  Store and Patreon.
- [Contact](https://www.dezzyne.com/contact/): Inquiries regarding games,
  virtual worlds, tooling, and studio partnerships.

## Official Profiles

- [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/dezzyne_soft)
